services.desc: Take a step back in time and explore Lorain County’s many historic places! Discover the past at your own pace with some information about the many interesting museums, monuments, and sites in our local communities. Plan your trip today! Historical Markers of Lorain CountyBrochure (opens as a printable PDF)Since 1957, the Ohio Historical Marker program, administered by the Ohio History Connection, has placed more than 1,700 markers around the state, including 36 in Lorain County. The markers identify, commemorate, and honor people, places, things, or events that have contributed to the rich history of our state and the nation.
